title: FastTTS: Accelerating Test-Time Scaling for Edge LLM Reasoning
authors_zh: Hao Mark Chen、Zhiwen Mo、Guanxi Lu、Shuang Liang、Lingxiao Ma、Wayne Luk、Hongxiang Fan（机构：帝国理工学院、微软研究院）
paper_type_zh: 测试时扩展推理服务系统论文
best_for_zh: 在严格 GPU 内存与延迟约束下部署验证器引导推理搜索的读者。
one_line: FastTTS accelerates verifier-guided test-time reasoning on a single edge GPU through speculative beam extension, prefix-aware scheduling, and asymmetric generator-verifier memory allocation.
FastTTS 通过推测式束扩展、前缀感知调度和生成器—验证器的非对称内存分配，在单张边缘 GPU 上加速验证器引导的测试时推理。
why: It treats test-time scaling as a systems scheduling problem and shows that the same search policy can be substantially faster without changing its algorithmic output.
inclusion_reason: It makes verifier-guided test-time search practical under fixed edge-device memory and latency constraints by changing how its inference compute is scheduled.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Verifier-guided test-time scaling can improve a small reasoning model by expanding several partial solution paths and repeatedly scoring them. On an edge device, however, this search does not resemble ordinary single-sequence decoding. Paths finish a reasoning step at different times, dynamically share and diverge from prefixes, and require both a generator and a verifier to occupy a small memory budget. A naive serving stack therefore spends part of its inference budget waiting for stragglers, recomputing cached prefixes, or constraining batches because the two models compete for memory.

The paper asks how to preserve the accuracy benefit of verifier-guided search while making its latency and goodput acceptable on a single consumer GPU. Its target is not a new reward model or search objective. Instead, it studies the execution pattern shared by beam search and related tree-style methods, then asks how the available test-time compute can be scheduled so that useful reasoning work, rather than hardware idle time, consumes the budget.

验证器引导的测试时扩展能够通过展开多条部分解答路径并反复为它们评分，提升小型推理模型的表现。但在边缘设备上，这种搜索并不像普通的单序列解码。不同路径完成一个推理步骤的时间不同，前缀会动态共享又分叉，生成器和验证器还必须共同占用很小的内存预算。因此，朴素服务栈会把部分推理预算浪费在等待慢路径、重新计算缓存前缀，或因两个模型争夺内存而压缩批大小上。

论文追问，如何保留验证器引导搜索的准确率收益，同时让它在单张消费级 GPU 上具有可接受的延迟和有效吞吐量。它的目标不是提出新的奖励模型或搜索目标，而是研究束搜索及相关树状方法共享的执行模式，再决定怎样调度可用的测试时计算，使预算消耗在有用的推理工作上，而不是消耗在硬件空闲时间上。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
FastTTS views verifier-guided reasoning as an iterative generation-verification loop over a dynamic tree. That view reveals three system-level opportunities. First, when some beams finish early, their unused execution slots can generate a carefully chosen amount of future work instead of waiting for the longest beam. Second, beams sharing a reasoning prefix should be scheduled together while that prefix remains in the KV cache. Third, the generator and verifier should not receive equal memory by default because decoding and verifier prefilling have different memory-throughput curves.

The key design constraint is algorithmic equivalence. Speculative work must not change which non-speculative beams the original search would select. The system therefore uses previous verifier scores as a cheap proxy for which completed beams are likely to survive, performs speculative extension only in otherwise idle slots, and truncates speculative tokens before ordinary branching. Scheduling and memory allocation then reduce overhead around the search instead of silently replacing the underlying reasoning policy.

FastTTS 将验证器引导的推理看作在动态树上反复进行的“生成—验证”循环。这一视角揭示了三类系统机会。第一，当某些束较早完成时，本来闲置的执行槽可以生成经过谨慎选择的后续工作，而不必等待最长的束。第二，共享同一推理前缀的束应在该前缀仍留在键值缓存中时被安排在一起。第三，生成器与验证器不应默认获得相等内存，因为解码与验证器预填充具有不同的内存—吞吐曲线。

关键设计约束是算法等价性。推测性工作不能改变原始搜索在非推测束中本会选择的结果。因此，系统用上一轮验证器分数作为廉价代理，判断哪些已完成束更可能被保留，只在原本闲置的槽中进行推测式扩展，并在常规分支前截去推测词元。调度和内存分配由此减少搜索周边开销，而不是悄悄替换底层推理策略。

title: Method
方法
html:
The system adds Speculative Beam Extension to the normal beam-search loop. During a generation step, a completed beam may become a speculative candidate according to the prior verifier score; as standard beams finish, available batch slots are filled with its possible future tokens. The system verifies only the ordinary beams, then selects and duplicates them as usual. Speculative tokens are truncated on the duplicates, so the verifier-guided search has the same logical decision path while straggler time is overlapped with potentially useful generation.

FastTTS also uses a two-phase, preemptible scheduler. It first batches active beams continuously within a request, then switches to speculative execution only when no queued standard beams remain; new requests immediately preempt speculation. Dynamic Prefix-Aware Scheduling groups beams with common prefixes to raise KV-cache reuse. Finally, Asymmetric Multi-Model Memory Allocation profiles the generator and process reward model separately and assigns more cache memory where it most improves end-to-end goodput. The implementation is a plug-in layer on vLLM for models of at most seven billion parameters on a 24 GB GPU.

系统把推测式束扩展加入常规束搜索循环。在一个生成步骤中，已完成的束会依据上一轮验证器分数成为推测候选；随着标准束完成，可用批槽会填入其可能的后续词元。系统只验证普通束，随后仍按原方式选择并复制它们。复制后的推测词元会被截断，因此验证器引导搜索保持相同的逻辑决策路径，而慢路径等待时间被与潜在有用的生成工作重叠起来。

FastTTS 还使用两阶段、可抢占调度器。它先在单个请求内部持续批处理活跃束，只有在没有排队的标准束时才转入推测执行；新请求会立刻抢占推测工作。动态前缀感知调度将共享前缀的束分组，以提高键值缓存复用。最后，生成器与过程奖励模型的非对称内存分配会分别分析二者特性，并把更多缓存内存分给最能提升端到端有效吞吐的位置。实现是构建在 vLLM 上的插件层，面向 24 GB GPU 上不超过七十亿参数的模型。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates verifier-guided beam search with Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B generators, together with Math-Shepherd-Mistral-7B-PRM and Skywork-o1-Open-PRM-Qwen-2.5-1.5B verifiers. Its evaluation covers AIME 2024, AMC 2023, and MATH-500, and the artifact appendix describes automated benchmark workflows, configuration files, JSONL logs, and reproduction scripts. The target hardware is a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 with 24 GB of memory, which makes the reported results directly relevant to constrained edge serving rather than unconstrained cluster inference.

Against the vLLM baseline, FastTTS reports an average 2.2-times improvement in goodput and a 38% to 68% reduction in latency while preserving the algorithmic output of the underlying verifier-guided search. The paper attributes the gain to complementary effects: speculative execution hides irregular beam lengths, prefix-aware ordering prevents avoidable KV-cache loss, and asymmetric memory allocation improves the generator-verifier balance. It also profiles the workload to show that verification has stable prefill behavior whereas generation becomes underutilized as beams finish unevenly.

论文使用 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 和 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 作为验证器引导束搜索的生成器，并配合 Math-Shepherd-Mistral-7B-PRM 与 Skywork-o1-Open-PRM-Qwen-2.5-1.5B 验证器。评测覆盖 AIME 2024、AMC 2023 和 MATH-500，产物附录还描述了自动化基准工作流、配置文件、JSONL 日志和复现脚本。目标硬件是一张拥有 24 GB 内存的 NVIDIA RTX 4090，因此这些结果直接对应受限边缘服务，而不是不受约束的集群推理。

相较 vLLM 基线，FastTTS 在保持底层验证器引导搜索算法输出不变的同时，报告平均 2.2 倍的有效吞吐提升和 38% 到 68% 的延迟下降。论文将增益归因于互补作用：推测执行隐藏不规则束长度，前缀感知排序避免可避免的键值缓存丢失，非对称内存分配改善生成器—验证器之间的平衡。它还通过工作负载剖析表明，验证阶段具有稳定的预填充行为，而随着束以不同速度完成，生成阶段会出现硬件利用不足。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's novelty is to make test-time scaling a first-class serving problem. Many reasoning papers specify how to spend extra inference computation but abstract away the irregular workload produced by verifier-guided trees. FastTTS identifies a common execution substrate across several such methods and optimizes the idle slots, memory placement, and prefix locality that this substrate creates. The result is not merely a faster decoder; it is a system tailored to the alternating generate-score-prune structure of reasoning search.

Speculative Beam Extension is particularly distinctive because it spends otherwise idle GPU capacity on future computation while preserving the original search semantics. The combined design connects algorithmic quality with systems metrics through goodput: tokens on paths that will be pruned should not be valued like tokens contributing to a final solution. This framing gives practical weight to latency, cache behavior, and multi-model memory allocation as dimensions of test-time scaling rather than implementation details after the fact.

论文的新意在于把测试时扩展作为一等的推理服务问题。许多推理论文规定了如何花费额外推理计算，却抽象掉验证器引导树所产生的不规则工作负载。FastTTS 识别出多种此类方法共有的执行底座，并优化由其产生的闲置槽、内存放置和前缀局部性。它不只是一个更快的解码器，而是专门适配推理搜索中“生成—评分—剪枝”交替结构的系统。

推测式束扩展尤其有特点，因为它把原本闲置的 GPU 容量用于未来计算，同时保留原始搜索语义。组合设计通过有效吞吐把算法质量与系统指标连接起来：未来会被剪枝路径上的词元不应与最终解答路径上的词元具有同等价值。这一框架使延迟、缓存行为和多模型内存分配成为测试时扩展的组成维度，而不是事后的实现细节。

title: Limitations
局限
html: FastTTS targets a specific hardware and workload regime: verifier-guided tree search on a memory-constrained edge GPU. Its gains depend on enough beam parallelism, useful correlation between past verifier scores and survival, exploitable prefix sharing, and the selected generator-verifier pair. The paper does not establish that the same scheduling choices dominate for long sequential chains, tools with variable external latency, different accelerators, or reward models whose step scores are unreliable. It describes a reproducibility artifact but the official paper does not provide a public repository URL, so independent reuse still requires locating its release and checking its terms.

FastTTS 面向特定的硬件与工作负载：内存受限边缘 GPU 上的验证器引导树搜索。它的增益依赖足够的束并行度、过去验证器分数与存活概率之间的有用相关性、可利用的前缀共享，以及所选择的生成器—验证器组合。论文没有证明同样的调度选择也适用于长串行思维链、具有可变外部延迟的工具、不同加速器，或步骤分数不可靠的奖励模型。它描述了可复现产物，但官方论文没有给出公开仓库地址，因此独立复用仍需定位发布版本并核查其条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this card when an inference team already has a verifier-guided search algorithm and needs to make it usable under a strict latency or VRAM envelope. The most portable lesson is to profile the alternating generator and verifier phases before optimizing either one in isolation: quantify straggler gaps, prefix-sharing locality, and each model's memory-throughput curve. The methods then suggest a disciplined systems plan—maintain search semantics, fill only truly idle slots, reuse dynamic prefixes, and allocate memory according to measured sensitivity.
当推理团队已经拥有验证器引导搜索算法，却需要在严格延迟或显存限制下使其可用时，可参考本卡。最可迁移的经验是，在单独优化生成器或验证器之前，先剖析二者交替阶段：量化慢路径差距、前缀共享局部性以及每个模型的内存—吞吐曲线。随后这些方法给出一套克制的系统方案——保持搜索语义，只填充真正闲置的槽，复用动态前缀，并依照测得的敏感性分配内存。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the system contribution together with the accuracy constraint. The paper is not claiming that speculative generations are intrinsically better reasoning; it claims they can turn waiting time into useful work without changing the verifier-guided search decision. Its reported goodput is therefore more informative than raw throughput. When comparing it with another serving result, first check whether both systems use the same search width, verifier, memory limit, batching policy, and definition of latency; otherwise a systems gain can be mistaken for a change in the amount or quality of reasoning compute.
阅读系统贡献时应同时关注准确率约束。论文并非声称推测生成天然产生更好的推理，而是声称它能在不改变验证器引导搜索决策的前提下，把等待时间转化为有用工作。因此，其报告的有效吞吐比原始吞吐更有信息量。与其他服务结果比较时，先检查两套系统是否使用相同的搜索宽度、验证器、内存限制、批处理策略和延迟定义；否则系统层面的提升可能被误认为推理计算量或推理质量的变化。
